payload.body: ISSUE:0004 at d8689e4: the fix is confirmed, and two small tests remain before Acceptance item 2 holds. Confirmed: green in a fresh clone (check all, test all with 34 bats, build, doctor, release check, the 0.1.6 dry run with gh reads only, the 0.1.5 dry run refused); my S05 copy of v0.1.5 is now refused as 'Unexpected release archive member'; reverting the fix (mac-ext on for both reads) goes red, and so does dropping the repack's COPYFILE_DISABLE, --no-xattrs and --no-mac-metadata, which a6c99b1 let through. Mutation pass, 55 mutations over macos, nopython, the formula template and build.yml. Two Python checks have no test that fails without them: (1) F10, the manifest's tag and identifier: drop either from check_signed's jq and the suite stays green, since only team_id is tested. Turning the team test into a loop over jq '.tag = "v0.0.1"', '.identifier = "com.example.ccusage"' and '.team_id = "0000000000"' covers all three. (2) F15, the check of the signed set before upload: drop 'check_sums $signed; check_signed $signed' and the suite stays green, because the post-upload check then refuses before publish. A test needs the signed set to fail only that check, eg the fake codesign serving a display with no Timestamp= line from its first display after sign()'s own verifies, asserting failed 'requires a secure timestamp' and absent '^gh release upload'. Redundant guards, no action: the listing count and the found count (dropping both goes red on the too-many test), the two mac-ext reads, and the missing-manifest-entry message. Optional nits, not blocking: nothing pins build.yml's SHA256SUMS.ci name, which the formula-before-finalize refusal rests on (revert it to SHA256SUMS and every check stays green); nopython's #! rule has no case the word rule does not also catch (eg a #! python line in a .md file). Send me the commit and I will rerun those mutations straight away.
